app.title: Aequitas — resolution workspace
app.description: A documented, human-reviewable dispute-resolution platform. Proposed outcomes are always distinguished from decisions, every material step is attributable, and no party is ever represented as having consented before it has done so.

newCase.title: Start a new case
newCase.noStatement: No consent statement is configured for locale {locale}. A case cannot be created until one is.
newCase.respondentNameHint: If they don't have an Aequitas account yet, one will be prepared for them. They join through an invitation link from the Aequitas team; no email is sent automatically.
newCase.categoryLabel: What kind of dispute is this?
newCase.disputeDescriptionHint: A short description of the dispute. This field is required.
newCase.amountHint: A rough figure is enough. Leave this blank if you do not know.
newCase.simulatedLabel: This is a simulated (training) case — no real counterparty or resolution.
newCase.acknowledgeLabel: I have read the consent statement above and voluntarily choose to participate.
newCase.error: The case could not be created.

action.submitChronology: add an event to the dispute chronology

header.authorityNone: No action is available to you at this stage.
header.closedNotice: This case is closed; no further action is possible.

draft.error: The case could not be submitted.

open.coiLabel: I have a conflict of interest with this case
open.error: Evidence intake could not be opened.

evidence.title: Evidence
evidence.empty: No evidence has been submitted yet.

form.fileHint: One file per submission, up to 25 MB. Files are scanned before they can be used.
form.success: Submission recorded. Check the scan status in the evidence list.
form.error: The evidence could not be submitted.

positions.title: Positions
positions.empty: No position has been submitted yet.

form.success: Your position has been recorded as a new version.
form.error: The position could not be submitted.

submission.title: Add to this case
submission.description: Choose what you want to submit. Each section explains when submissions are available to you.
submission.evidenceHelp: Attach the documents, photos, messages or receipts supporting your account. Add a title and optional description for each file.
submission.positionHelp: Explain your account, refer to your evidence and dated events, and describe the outcome you are seeking. New submissions retain earlier versions.

availability.submitCaseFirst: Submit this draft case first. A case manager then opens evidence intake.
availability.waitingForManager: Waiting for a case manager to open evidence intake.
availability.afterEvidence: Position submissions open after the case manager closes evidence intake.
availability.intakeClosed: Evidence intake is closed. You can read the record, but cannot add evidence or dated events at this stage.
availability.readOnly: Submissions are closed at this stage. Previously submitted material remains available to read.
availability.partiesOnly: Only the parties to this case can submit. Case managers review their submissions.

chronology.title: Dispute chronology
chronology.description: Add events from the dispute using the date they happened, not the date you submit them. Both parties can read these accounts; they are reported events, not verified findings.
chronology.empty: No dispute events have been added yet.

form.hint: Explain what you observed and identify supporting evidence. If a date or detail is uncertain, say so. Submitted entries are retained; add a clarification rather than overwriting an account.
form.success: Your event has been added to the dispute chronology.
form.error: The event could not be added. Check the date and required fields, and whether evidence intake is still open. Your text has been kept.

intake.overrideLabel: Override reason (required if a party has not submitted evidence)
intake.error: Evidence intake could not be closed.

draftRequest.error: The draft recommendation could not be requested.

consent.title: Consent
consent.givenStatus: You have given your consent to this recommendation.
consent.error: Your response could not be recorded.

withdraw.confirmPrompt: Are you sure you want to withdraw this case? This cannot be undone.
withdraw.error: The case could not be withdrawn.

close.error: The case could not be closed.

export.link: Download the sealed case record (PDF + JSON)

recommendation.title: Recommendation
recommendation.draftHeading: Draft recommendation (visible to case managers only)

checklist.reviewedEvidence: I have reviewed the cited evidence.
checklist.confirmedLimits: I confirm the stated limits are accurate.
checklist.acceptsResponsibility: I accept responsibility as the issuing reviewer.

recommendation.error: The recommendation could not be issued.

claims.title: Claims on this case
claims.description: A claim is shown as something Aequitas says only when a person has linked a verbatim excerpt from a source. A statement without that excerpt stays marked as needing evidence.
claims.empty: No claim with a verbatim excerpt is recorded yet.
claims.needsEvidenceNotice: This statement stays marked as needing evidence until a verbatim excerpt is linked. It is not shown as a claim.
claims.redacted: The excerpt is restricted. The restriction is recorded on the source.
claims.impactNotice: Impact statement. This is reported experience. It is not shown as a factual claim.
claims.noRelationships: No relationship between claims is recorded yet.

relationPredicate.ALLEGED_TO_HAVE_CONTRIBUTED_TO: is alleged to have contributed to

form.rationaleHint: Required when confidence is disputed or unknown. Say what is still missing.
form.excerptHint: Quote the source as written. Without a verbatim excerpt, the claim cannot be shown as anything but needing evidence.
form.sourceBodyHint: Optional. A later proposal is kept only when its excerpt appears here word for word.
form.error: That record could not be saved.

pipeline.title: Assumption ledger
pipeline.description: Assumptions stay visible. A person acknowledges them before the pipeline may propose claims.
pipeline.proposalsDescription: The model only proposes. Nothing here is a claim until the case manager accepts it.
pipeline.flagsNote: These are flags. They are not a numeric result.
pipeline.modelOff: The free model is not configured, so new proposals are not requested.
pipeline.runAssumptions: Extract assumptions from the case framing
pipeline.runClaims: Propose claims from the source text
pipeline.runContext: Propose context factors from accepted claims

diagE.insufficient: Evidence is not yet enough to carry a sentence
diagE.single_source: A sentence rests on one source
diagE.corroborated: An established sentence cites more than one source
diagE.disputed_present: A disputed claim is in the file

diagC.third_factor_missing: A third-factor context record is missing
diagC.third_factor_recorded: A third-factor context record is present

timeline.title: Case activity
timeline.description: An automatic log of actions taken in Aequitas. These timestamps record submissions and case progress, not when events in the dispute happened.

event.CASE_ASSIGNED: Case assigned to a case manager
event.RECOMMENDATION_DRAFT_FAILED: Draft generation failed; the case can be retried
event.CLAIM_EVIDENCE_LINKED: Claim linked to a verbatim excerpt
event.ASSUMPTION_REVISED: Assumption revised; the earlier text remains
event.ASSUMPTION_ADDED_MID_CASE: Assumption added after the case was underway
event.PIPELINE_RETURNED: Pipeline returned to an earlier stage
event.RESOLUTION_APPROVED: Approver signed off on the recommendation

resolution.title: Contestation and sign-off
resolution.consentOnly: This case was opened before approver sign-off existed. It resolves when both parties give consent, as before.
resolution.approvalPath: An approver who does not own this case signs off on the issued recommendation first. Then both parties give or decline consent.
resolution.noBlockers: Nothing blocks resolution. Consent from both parties can resolve the case.
resolution.notApproved: No approver has signed off on the current recommendation.
resolution.noContestations: No contestation has been opened on this case.
resolution.openHeading: Contest an item on this case
resolution.error: The action could not be completed. Reload and try again.

code.OPEN_CONTESTATION: A contestation is still open. It must be answered, overruled, or withdrawn before the case can resolve.
code.APPROVAL_REQUIRED: An approver must sign off on the current recommendation before consent can resolve the case.
code.ADMIN_CANNOT_APPROVE: Administrators cannot sign off or overrule.
code.NOT_APPROVER: Only a designated approver can sign off or overrule.
code.PARTY_CANNOT_APPROVE: A party to the case cannot sign off or overrule.
code.SAME_AUTHOR: The case manager who owns this case, or who wrote its recommendation or synthesis, cannot also sign off on it.
code.MISSING_RATIONALE: A written rationale or reason is required.
code.NO_ISSUED_RECOMMENDATION: Sign-off applies to an issued recommendation.
code.ALREADY_APPROVED: This recommendation version already has a sign-off.
code.CONTESTATION_NOT_OPEN: This contestation is no longer open.
code.TARGET_NOT_ON_CASE: That item is not on this case.
code.CASE_NOT_CONTESTABLE: Contestations cannot be opened or changed at this stage of the case.

knowledgeMap.title: Conflict knowledge map
knowledgeMap.limits: Assessments remain open to human review. Source descriptions are metadata; extracted text and OCR carry their own limits and must be checked against the original.
knowledgeMap.noExperience: No lived experience was explicitly reported in the supplied record.

knowledgeReview.title: Review and correct this draft
knowledgeReview.help: Save a new version with your reason. Sources and original quotations remain traceable; the revised draft still requires human issuance. References identify the linked claims and relationships.
knowledgeReview.error: The review could not be saved. Your edits are preserved.

knowledgeGraph.title: Explore connections and original sources
knowledgeGraph.help: Follow a claim to its quotation, compare related interpretations, or inspect the preserved source text.
knowledgeGraph.select: Choose a claim, interpretation or source

invite.title: Activate your Aequitas account
invite.greeting: Hello {name}. You have been invited to Aequitas as: {role}.
invite.explain: Create a passkey on this device to activate your account. No password: your device confirms it's you. This link works only once.
invite.invalid: This invitation link is invalid or has expired. Ask the Aequitas team for a new link.
invite.alreadyClaimed: This account has already been activated. Sign in with your passkey.
invite.failed: Activation failed or was cancelled. Try again or request a new invitation.

landing.title: Aequitas
landing.tagline: A record both sides can read.
landing.lead: Aequitas supports dispute resolution: each party submits its evidence and position, a neutral case manager reviews a proposed outcome, and nothing is concluded without each party's explicit consent.
landing.intro: Bring your evidence, share your perspective, and work toward a proposed outcome with a neutral case manager.

evidence.title: Share the facts
evidence.description: Each party adds evidence and explains their point of view in the same case record.

review.title: Review a proposal
review.description: A neutral case manager reviews the proposed outcome before it is shared with the parties.

consent.title: Choose whether to consent
consent.description: Each party decides explicitly. A proposed outcome becomes an agreement only with both parties' consent.

submissions.title: Where to submit your material
submissions.path: Sign in, open My cases, then select a case with View. To begin a case, choose Start a new case from that list.

evidence.title: Evidence
evidence.description: In the case's Evidence section, attach a file with a title and optional description while evidence intake is open.

chronology.title: Dispute chronology
chronology.description: In Dispute chronology, add each event's date, title and your account of what happened during evidence intake.

position.title: Your position
position.description: In Positions, explain your account and the outcome you are seeking once the case manager closes evidence intake.

submissions.note: Submissions are made by the parties inside their case, not on this public page. The case workspace explains any unavailable action.

landing.footer: Proposals are reviewed by a person. Consent belongs to each party.

auth.tagline: a record both sides can read
auth.cancelled: Sign-in was cancelled or timed out. You can try again.
auth.failed: Unable to sign in. Check your email and use a passkey registered for this account, or contact your administrator.
auth.passkeyNote: No password to remember. Your device confirms it is you.

adminInvites.title: Manage invitations
adminInvites.explain: Invite someone to claim their account with a passkey. Issuing a new invitation revokes their older unused links.
adminInvites.emailUnavailable: Email is not configured yet. You can share the invitation link directly.
adminInvites.failed: The request failed. Check the account and try again.
adminInvites.mailPending: Some notifications remain pending. Try again after checking email configuration.
adminInvites.mailAccepted: Pending notifications were accepted by the email provider.

delivery.manual: Invitation created. Share the link with the intended recipient.
delivery.accepted: Invitation created and accepted by Resend for delivery.
delivery.failed: Invitation created, but the email failed. Share this link directly or issue another invitation.
delivery.not_configured: Invitation created. Email is not configured; share this link directly.
